title: Battle HUD Skin
description: Semantic source of truth for the battle HUD visuals (hero HP / AP / deck icons + CGB palettes, and the turn-timer bar). The JSON->C compiler emits the const g_hud_skin (bank 4) staged into WRAM at battle entry. Icons resolve to the fixed VRAM icon tiles ui_init loads (UI_TILE_CARD_* 104-112, UI_TILE_HEART 113, UI_TILE_BOLT 114, UI_TILE_COIN 115, UI_TILE_DECK 116, bar segments 117/127); colors to UI_COLOR_* palette indices. Layout rows/cols live per battle screen (screens/battle/*.json hud_layout).

id.description: Singleton id (one HUD skin per game).

hp.description: Hero HP icon (drawn at the hero row, before 'HP:').

bar.description: Turn-timer bar: one segment tile per column; filled while the timer has time left, empty after.

filled.description: Tile for an unexpired segment (default bar_filled, VRAM 117).

empty.description: Tile for an expired segment (default bar_empty, VRAM 127).

color.description: CGB BG palette (UI_COLOR_*) applied to the filled span.

row.description: Tilemap row of the bar (default 17, bottom row).

icon.description: Which VRAM icon tile represents this HUD element. Names are the slugified combat-tileset description entries (assets/combat-tileset-description.csv); dagger/ring/amulet have no CSV entry (atlas-only) and keep plain names.
